title: Process Reward Modeling with Reliability- and Conservatism-Aware Bayesian Belief
abstract: arXiv:2610.23223v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) play a central role in test-time scaling for large language model (LLM) reasoning. However, PRMs may provide inaccurate process rewards for test-time scaling, which we identify as arising from two sources of uncertainty: (1) \textit{PRM uncertainty} that arises from insufficient supervision data and imperfect PRM training; and (2) \textit{policy uncertainty} that results from the mismatch between the policy to collect supervision data and the policy for test-time scaling, leading to systematic reward overestimation. Previous studies fail to jointly consider both uncertainties. To bridge this gap, we propose BayesianPRM, which treats the process reward as a random variable within a reward hypothesis space and maintains a Bayesian belief over it. translated_title: 基于可靠性与保守性感知的贝叶斯信念的过程奖励建模
translated_abstract: 过程奖励模型在大语言模型推理的测试时扩展中扮演着核心角色。然而，PRM可能会在测试时扩展中提供不准确的过程奖励，我们识别出这源于两种不确定性来源：（1）*PRM不确定性*，源于监督数据不足和PRM训练不完善；（2）*策略不确定性*，源于收集监督数据的策略与测试时扩展所使用策略之间的不匹配，导致系统性的奖励高估。以往的研究未能同时考虑这两种不确定性。为弥补这一空白，我们提出BayesianPRM，它将过程奖励视为奖励假设空间中的随机变量，并对其维护贝叶斯信念。由于在连续假设空间上进行精确贝叶斯推断通常是不可解的，我们使用奖励集成对奖励假设空间进行离散化……
tldr: 提出BayesianPRM，将过程奖励视为随机变量并维护贝叶斯信念，首次同时建模PRM不确定性与策略不确定性两类来源，从而缓解测试时扩展中系统性奖励高估的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes BayesianPRM, which treats process rewards as random variables with maintained Bayesian beliefs to jointly capture both PRM uncertainty and policy uncertainty, mitigating systematic reward overestimation in test-time scaling.
